procedure: State: Several long count sequences overlap, contain possible omitted/duplicated increments and admit competing offsets. Procedure: Construct competing offset/gap assignments jointly across all overlaps, reject assignments inconsistent with measurement bounds or independent anchors, and choose the one allowed anchor check where surviving chronologies differ. Recheck global consistency after that observation. Limits and stopping conditions: Correlated disturbance, reference error, weak overlap and nonunique alignments remain possible; no chronology proves authorship or intention.
